title: Renewal Calendar Event Renewal Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event renewal_amount_usd=*
| stats sum(renewal_amount_usd) as total_value, avg(renewal_amount_usd) as avg_value by vendor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks vendor name values by total and average renewal amount across renewal calendar event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `renewal_amount_usd` values for each renewal calendar event event and review total and average renewal amount by vendor name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total renewal amount.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which vendor name shows the biggest renewal amount numbers in your renewal calendar event data.
